scripts.dev: bash scripts/dev-env.sh prepare && python3 scripts/dev-supervisor.py --frontend-port 5174 --backend-port 8000 --frontend-command 'npm run dev --prefix frontend' --backend-command '.venv/bin/python -m uvicorn app.main:app --reload --port 8000' --backend-cwd backend
scripts.check: npm run check:worktree && npm run check:frontend && npm run check:backend && npm run test:production-db-gate
scripts.check:worktree: bash scripts/test-worktree.sh && bash scripts/test-playwright-mcp.sh && bash scripts/test-dev-env.sh && bash scripts/test-backend-runtime.sh && bash scripts/test-db-plan.sh && python3 scripts/test-dev-supervisor.py
scripts.check:frontend: npm run lint --prefix frontend && npm run test --prefix frontend && npm run build --prefix frontend
scripts.check:backend: uv run --directory backend ruff check . && uv run --directory backend ruff format --check . && uv run --directory backend python -m unittest discover -s tests -v
